DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 検査のご案内で、何かわからないことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is there anything you do not understand in the examination instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 読もうとしたのですが、文字が小さくて見づらいです。大きな文字のものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 説明書の文字が小さく見づらいので、大きな文字のものを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I tried to read them, but the print is small and hard to see. Do you have a large-print version?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the instructions are hard to see because the print is small, and request a large-print version.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 拡大したものを用意します。読みにくさ以外に、確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will prepare an enlarged copy. Apart from difficulty reading it, is there anything you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 検査後の見え方について書いてある部分がわかりません。今日、自転車で帰ってよいのか担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 検査後の見え方の説明が不明で、今日自転車で帰れるか検査担当者に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I do not understand the section about how my vision will be after the examination. I would like to ask the person conducting it whether I can cycle home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not understand the information about vision after the examination and want to ask the examiner whether you can cycle home today.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どの検査を行うかも含め、検査担当に確認してもらいます。ご自宅までは遠いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will have the examination staff check, including which examination you will have. Is your home far away?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 歩くと三十分ほどです。帰り方を決めたいので、検査の前に説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家まで徒歩三十分で、帰り方を決めるため検査前に説明を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It is about thirty minutes on foot. I want to decide how to get home, so I would like to hear the explanation before the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that home is a thirty-minute walk away and you want an explanation before the examination to decide how to get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: わかりました。まだ説明が済んでいないと担当へ伝えます。この書類への署名はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I will tell the person responsible that the explanation has not been completed yet. Have you signed this document?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだです。内容を理解してから署名したいので、今は空欄のままにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: まだ署名しておらず、理解してから署名するため空欄にしていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Not yet. I would like to sign after understanding the contents, so I have left it blank for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not signed yet and have left it blank so that you can sign after understanding it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が拡大した案内を使って説明します。その場で聞き直していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. The person responsible will explain using enlarged instructions. You can ask for clarification there.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。検査の内容と帰宅時の注意を聞き、自分の言葉でも確認してから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 検査内容と帰宅時の注意を聞き、自分の言葉で理解を確認してから判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I will hear about the examination and precautions for going home, then check my understanding in my own words before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hear about the examination and precautions for going home and check your understanding in your own words before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 受付でわからなかった点を担当へ引き継ぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。説明の順番までこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will pass on to the person responsible the points you did not understand at reception. Thank you for asking. Please wait here until it is your turn for an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。お忘れ物について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your lost property?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、昨日の夜、奥の四人席を使いました。紺色の上着を受け取りに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 前夜に奥の四人席を使い、紺色の上着を受け取りに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I used the table for four at the back last night. I have come to collect a navy-blue jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you used the table for four at the back the previous night and have come to collect a navy-blue jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの紺色の上着でしょうか。特徴を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is it this navy-blue jacket? Could you describe any identifying features?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私のは内側に名前を書いた白い布を縫い付けています。この上着には見当たらないので、別の方のものかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分の上着には内側に名前入りの白い布があり、提示された品にはないので別人のものかもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Mine has a white piece of cloth with my name written on it sewn inside. I cannot see it on this jacket, so this may belong to someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your jacket has a white cloth with your name inside, and the jacket shown may be someone else's because it lacks that feature.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: よく似たものがもう一着あります。ほかに確認できる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: There is another very similar one. Are there any other features we can check?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 右のポケットに、角が折れた映画の半券を入れたままです。勝手にポケットを探らず、お店の方に確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 右ポケットの角が折れた映画の半券を目印として伝え、店員による確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I left a cinema ticket stub with a folded corner in the right pocket. I would like a staff member to check rather than searching the pocket myself without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the cinema ticket stub with a folded corner in the right pocket as an identifying feature, and ask staff to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認します。こちらには白い布と半券があります。布のお名前を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will check. This one has a white cloth and a ticket stub. May I ask the name on the cloth?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: カタカナでグエンと書いてあります。半券には昨日より前の日付が印刷されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 布にはカタカナでグエンと書かれ、半券の日付は昨日より前だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: It says Nguyen in katakana. The ticket stub has a date printed on it from before yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the cloth says Nguyen in katakana and the ticket stub is dated before yesterday.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 両方とも一致しました。こちらの上着をお返しします。ほかのお忘れ物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Both match. I will return this jacket to you. Have you lost anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 上着だけです。受け取ったらポケットの中身も確認します。最初の上着は別の方へ返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 忘れ物は上着だけで中身も確認し、最初の品は別の持ち主へ返してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Just the jacket. I will also check the contents of the pockets when I receive it. Please return the first jacket to its other owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that only the jacket was lost, you will check its contents, and you would like the first item returned to its other owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。最初の品は引き続き保管します。お受け取りありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. We will continue keeping the first item here. Thank you for collecting yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お持ち帰りのご注文についてのお電話ですね。お名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: You are calling about a takeaway order, correct? May I have your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 六時に天ぷら二人分を予約したグエンです。到着が遅れそうなので、受取りを六時半に変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 六時に天ぷら二人分を予約した名前を伝え、到着が遅れるため六時半への変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: This is Nguyen. I reserved tempura for two people for six o'clock. I expect to arrive late; could I change collection to six thirty?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give in Japanese the name under which you reserved tempura for two at six, and request a change to six thirty because you will arrive late.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご予約を確認しました。今はまだ揚げていません。六時半なら、調理の開始を遅らせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have confirmed your booking. We have not fried it yet. If it is six thirty, we can delay starting the cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 助かります。もし先に揚げていたらそのまま受け取るつもりでしたが、まだなら六時半に合わせてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: すでに揚げていたらそのまま受け取るつもりだったが、調理前なので六時半に合わせてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: That helps. I was going to collect it as it was if it had already been fried, but since it has not, please time it for six thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you intended to collect it as it was if already fried, but since cooking has not started you would like it timed for six thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受取りを六時半に変更します。ご注文の内容や数に変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will change collection to six thirty. Are there any changes to the items or quantities in your order?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 天ぷら二人分のままです。ご飯は注文していません。数を増やしたり減らしたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文は天ぷら二人分だけでご飯はなく、数量や内容は変更しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: It is still tempura for two. I did not order rice. I am neither increasing nor decreasing the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the order remains only tempura for two, without rice, and that neither the quantity nor contents will change.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 内容はそのままですね。お連れ様が代わりに受け取る可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The contents remain the same, then. Might someone accompanying you collect it on your behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、私が間に合わなければ妻が受け取ります。予約のグエンという名前を伝えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 間に合わなければ妻が予約名グエンを伝えて代理で受け取ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, my wife will collect it if I cannot make it in time. I will have her give Nguyen as the booking name.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that if you cannot arrive in time, your wife will collect on your behalf using the booking name Nguyen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。受取り時刻は六時半、ご予約名はグエンで変更しました。さらに遅れる場合はご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I have changed the collection time to six thirty under the name Nguyen. Please contact us if you will be any later.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六時半にグエンの予約で受け取ります。さらに遅れそうなら、時刻を過ぎる前に電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 六時半に予約名で受け取り、さらに遅れるなら時刻を過ぎる前に電話すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will collect at six thirty under Nguyen's booking. If I expect to be any later, I will call before that time passes.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will collect at six thirty under the booking name and call before that time if you will be later.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お待ちしています。お気を付けてお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: We will be expecting you. Please travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お持ちの傘についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Welcome. Are you asking about the umbrella you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 昨日ここで買いましたが、閉じた時に留め具が留まりません。見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 前日この店で買った傘の留め具が留まらないので確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I bought it here yesterday, but the fastener will not stay closed when I close the umbrella. Could you take a look?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a check of the umbrella bought at this shop yesterday because its fastener will not close.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認します。お買上げを確認できるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will check. Do you have anything showing your purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: このレシートです。袋から出して開閉した時に気づき、まだ外では使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: レシートを示し、袋から出して開閉した時に気づき、外では未使用だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is the receipt. I noticed when I took it out of the bag and opened and closed it. I have not used it outdoors yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the receipt in Japanese and explain that you noticed when opening and closing the umbrella after removing it from the bag, and have not used it outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 留め具が欠けていますね。この品は交換できます。ただ、同じ柄の在庫がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The fastener is chipped. We can exchange this item. However, the same pattern is out of stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ大きさなら別の柄でも構いません。持ち手の形はこの傘と同じものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同じ大きさなら柄の変更を受け入れるが、持ち手の形は同じものを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: A different pattern is fine as long as it is the same size. I would like one with the same handle shape as this umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Accept a different pattern in Japanese if the size is the same, but request the same handle shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの無地の傘は大きさも持ち手も同じで、値段も変わりません。ご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: This plain umbrella has the same size and handle, and the price is the same. Would you like to see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、これにします。交換前に、開閉と留め具をここで確かめてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 無地の傘を選び、交換前に開閉と留め具を店内で確認してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I will take this one. Before exchanging it, may I check here that it opens and closes and that the fastener works?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose the plain umbrella in Japanese and ask to check its opening, closing, and fastener in the shop before exchanging it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もちろんです。通路を避けて、こちらの空いた場所でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Of course. Please check in this clear space, away from the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 開閉できて、留め具も留まりました。この無地の傘に交換してください。元の傘はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 開閉と留め具が正常だと確認し、無地への交換と元の傘の返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: It opened and closed, and the fastener stayed closed too. Please exchange it for this plain umbrella. I will return the original one.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the opening, closing, and fastener work, and request exchange for the plain umbrella while returning the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 交換を承りました。変更をレシートに記入します。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: We have accepted the exchange. I will note the change on the receipt. Thank you for asking. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 返送された郵便物についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you asking about mail that was returned to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、申請書を送ったら戻ってきました。宛先が間違っているのか、出し直す前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 申請書が返送され、宛先が誤っているか再送前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I sent an application form, but it came back. I would like to check whether the address is wrong before sending it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your application was returned and you want to check whether the address is incorrect before resending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 封筒の住所と、提出先からの案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you show me the address on the envelope and the instructions from the office receiving the application?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: これが封筒で、こちらが提出先から届いた新しい案内です。封筒は以前の控えを見て書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 封筒と新しい案内を示し、封筒は以前の控えを見て書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: This is the envelope, and these are the new instructions I received from the office. I wrote the envelope using an old copy I had kept.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and new instructions in Japanese, and explain that you addressed the envelope using an earlier copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 新しい案内には建物名の後に三〇二号室がありますが、封筒には部屋番号がありません。郵便局では相手の現在の住所までは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The new instructions have room 302 after the building name, but there is no room number on the envelope. The post office cannot verify the recipient's current address.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 部屋番号が抜けていたんですね。この案内が現在の送付先か、提出先にも確認してから書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 部屋番号の抜けを理解し、新しい案内が現在の送付先か提出先に確認してから書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: So the room number was missing. I will also check with the receiving office that these instructions show the current mailing address before rewriting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand the room number is missing and will rewrite the address after checking with the receiving office that the new instructions show the current destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認できたら新しい封筒でお出しいただけます。申請の期限は迫っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Once you have confirmed it, you can send it in a new envelope. Is the application deadline near?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 期限は明後日です。郵送で間に合うと決めつけず、提出先に窓口への持参や期限の扱いも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 期限は明後日で、郵送到着を前提にせず持参や期限の扱いを提出先に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The deadline is the day after tomorrow. Rather than assume it will arrive by post in time, I will also ask the receiving office about hand-delivery to the counter and how the deadline is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the deadline is the day after tomorrow and you will ask the receiving office about hand-delivery and deadline rules without assuming postal delivery will be in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そのほうが提出方法を判断できます。郵送にする場合は、改めて配達の見込みをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: That will help you decide how to submit it. If you choose to post it, we will explain the expected delivery timing again.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今日はまだ出し直しません。送付先と提出方法を確認し、郵送を選ぶなら直した住所で持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 今日は再送せず、送付先と方法を確認し、郵送を選んだ場合に修正した住所で持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will not resend it today. I will confirm the destination and submission method, and if I choose post I will bring it back with the corrected address.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not resend today, will check the destination and method, and will bring it with the corrected address if you choose post.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 返送された封筒も確認が終わるまで残してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HACHINOHE-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please keep the returned envelope until you finish checking as well. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。見学のことで何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your visit?

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で案内に参加したいのですが、私は途中で帰ります。途中で抜けてもよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で案内に参加したいが自分は途中で帰るため、途中退出について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two of us would like to join the guided tour, but I will leave partway through. I would like to discuss whether leaving midway is allowed.
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that two people want to join the guided tour but you will leave early, and ask about leaving partway through.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この回では途中退出できます。何時ごろまで参加できますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may leave partway through this session. Until about what time can you stay?

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は二時までです。友人は最後まで見たいので、二人一緒に途中で帰るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は二時まで参加でき、友人は最後まで見たいので一緒に帰る予定ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can stay until two. My friend wants to see everything until the end, so we are not planning to leave early together.
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can participate until two and your friend wants to stay to the end, so you will not leave together.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の案内は一時から三十分ほどです。終了後に自由に見学する時間を分ければ、案内の途中で抜けずに済みます。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's guided tour starts at one and lasts about thirty minutes. If you separate your free viewing time afterward, you will not have to leave during the guided tour.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内は一緒に聞けるんですね。その後、友人と別れて帰る場所を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内を一緒に聞けると理解し、終了後に友人と別れる地点を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: So we can listen to the guided tour together. I would like to decide where to part from my friend afterward to go home.
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand you can attend the guided tour together and want to decide where to part from your friend afterward.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内の終了地点はこの地図の丸印です。そこから受付へ戻る道も示してあります。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: The tour finishes at the circle on this map. The route back to reception from there is marked too.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸印の所で別れます。私は受付へ戻り、友人には帰ったとメッセージを送ります。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図の丸印で別れ、自分は受付へ戻り、友人に帰ったとメッセージを送ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will part at the circle. I will return to reception and send my friend a message saying I have left.
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will part at the circle on the map, return to reception yourself, and message your friend that you have left.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら合流する必要はありませんね。ご友人は一人で見学を続けてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then you will not need to meet up again. Is it all right for your friend to continue looking around alone?

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、友人にも地図を渡します。一時の案内には二人で参加し、終わってから別行動にします。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人にも地図を渡し、一時の案内は二人で聞き、終了後に別行動にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will give my friend a map too. We will both join the one-o'clock guided tour and go our separate ways after it finishes.
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will also give your friend a map, both attend the one-o'clock tour, and separate afterward.

DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。地図を二枚お渡しします。お二人とも見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-AOM-HIROSAKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will give you two maps. I hope you both enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。作業について確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you would like to check about the work?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このりんごに小さな穴があります。普通の収穫箱に入れる前に、見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 穴のあるりんごを通常の箱に入れる前に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This apple has a small hole. Could you look at it before I put it in the regular harvest box?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the apple with a hole to be checked before putting it in the regular box.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見せてください。ほかの実と混ぜましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me. Have you mixed it with the other fruit?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ混ぜていません。一個だけ手元に残しています。同じ枝の実も気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実はまだ混ぜず一個だけ手元に残し、同じ枝の実も気になると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I am keeping just this one with me. I am also concerned about the fruit on the same branch.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not mixed it in, have kept this one separately, and are also concerned about fruit on the same branch.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この実は確認用の箱へ入れてください。穴の原因は見ただけでは決めません。同じ枝の実はまだ取っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put this apple in the box for checking. We will not decide what caused the hole just by looking. Have you not picked the fruit on the same branch yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ木に付いています。自分で全部取ったり捨てたりせず、場所をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ枝の実は未収穫で、勝手に取り切ったり捨てたりせず場所を伝えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is still on the tree. I will tell you the location instead of picking it all or throwing it away on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the fruit on the same branch is unpicked, and you will indicate the location without picking it all or discarding it without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。どの木の、どのあたりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Which tree, and whereabouts on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三列目の赤い目印の木です。通路側の低い枝なので、私がそこまで案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三列目の赤い目印の木の通路側の低い枝だと説明し、現地へ案内できると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The tree with the red marker in the third row. It is a low branch on the aisle side, so I can take you there.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is the low branch facing the aisle on the red-marked tree in the third row, and offer to guide the person there.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、私が確認します。その間は別の列で、今日の基準に合う実を収穫してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will check it. In the meantime, harvest fruit meeting today's criteria in another row.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この一個は確認用の箱へ入れ、三列目の木を案内してから別の列へ移ります。気になる枝の実は触りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一個を確認用の箱に入れ、木を案内して別の列へ移り、気になる枝には触らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put this one in the checking box, show you the third-row tree, then move to another row. I will not touch the fruit on the branch I am concerned about.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will place the apple in the checking box, show the tree, move to another row, and not touch the concerning branch.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順序でお願いします。声をかけてくれてありがとうございます。迷う実があれば、箱に混ぜる前にまた確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that order. Thank you for letting me know. If you are unsure about any fruit, ask again before mixing it into the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご予約や展示について、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with bookings or the exhibits?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 体験展示を予約したグエンです。この予約画面で受付をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約者名と予約画面を示して体験展示の受付を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am Nguyen, and I booked the interactive exhibition. Could you check me in using this booking screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your booking name and show the booking screen in Japanese to request check-in for the interactive exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面を確認します。ご予約は明日の十時になっていますが、今日は参加をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the screen. Your booking is for ten tomorrow; would you like to participate today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日だと思って来てしまいました。今日の回に空きがあれば変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日付を今日だと取り違えたと認め、空きがあれば今日の回へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I came thinking it was today. If there is space in a session today, I would like to change to that.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that you mistook the date for today, and request a change to today's session if space is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の体験は満席です。明日のご予約を取り消すことはできますが、まずご予定を確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's interactive sessions are fully booked. You can cancel tomorrow's booking, but would you like to check your plans first?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人と予定を確認したいです。今ここで取り消さず、少し待っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の予定を確認するため、すぐ取り消さず少し待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to check my friend's plans. Could you wait a little without cancelling it here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to wait a little without cancelling immediately so you can check your friend's plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。明日の枠はそのままにしておきます。確認できたらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. I will leave tomorrow's slot as it is. Let me know once you have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人も明日の十時に来られます。予約は変更せず、今日は常設展示だけ見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人も翌日十時に来られるため予約を残し、今日は常設展示だけ見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend can also come at ten tomorrow. I will leave the booking unchanged and would like to see only the permanent exhibition today.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your friend can come at ten tomorrow too, so you will retain the booking and see only the permanent exhibition today.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の常設展示はこちらで入館できます。明日の体験予約とは別の受付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. You can enter today's permanent exhibition here. This check-in is separate from tomorrow's interactive exhibition booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の入館と明日の体験は別ですね。今日は常設展示を見て、明日は予約画面を持って十時前に受付へ来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の入館と翌日の体験は別だと理解し、明日は予約画面を持って十時前に来ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: So today's admission and tomorrow's interactive exhibition are separate. I will see the permanent exhibition today and come to reception before ten tomorrow with the booking screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that today's admission and tomorrow's interactive exhibition are separate and you will come before ten tomorrow with the booking screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、明日のご予約はそのままです。今日は常設展示をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, tomorrow's booking remains unchanged. Please enjoy the permanent exhibition today.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚に入れる収納箱を探しています。棚の内側を測ってきたので、合う箱を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測ってきた棚の内寸に合う収納箱を探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a storage box to put on a shelf. I measured the inside of the shelf and would like to choose a box that fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want a storage box fitting the shelf's internal dimensions you measured.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 幅、高さ、奥行きを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me the width, height, and depth?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅が三十センチ、高さが十八センチ、奥行きが二十五センチです。ふた付きの箱が欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚の幅三十、高さ十八、奥行き二十五センチを伝え、ふた付きの箱を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is thirty centimetres wide, eighteen high, and twenty-five deep. I would like a box with a lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the shelf's width of thirty, height of eighteen, and depth of twenty-five centimetres in Japanese, and request a lidded box.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この箱は幅二十八、高さ十七、奥行き二十四センチです。ただ、高さはふたを外した状態の表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This box is twenty-eight centimetres wide, seventeen high, and twenty-four deep. However, the listed height is measured without the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ふたなしでは入っても、ふたを付けたら入らないかもしれません。付けた高さを確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふたを付けると入らない可能性があるため、ふたを含む高さを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if it fits without a lid, it may not fit with the lid on. Could you check its height with the lid?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the height including the lid because it may not fit with the lid on.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ふたを付けると十九センチです。こちらの浅い箱なら、ふたを含めて十五センチです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: With the lid, it is nineteen centimetres high. This shallower box is fifteen centimetres high including the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 深い方は高さが合わないので、浅い方にします。浅い方の幅と奥行きも棚に収まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 高さが合わない深い箱をやめて浅い箱を選び、幅と奥行きも収まるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The deeper one is too tall, so I will take the shallow one. Will the shallow one's width and depth fit on the shelf too?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the shallow box instead of the deep one whose height does not fit, and ask in Japanese whether its width and depth fit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 浅い方は幅二十六、奥行き二十二センチです。お持ちの寸法より小さいですね。ふたは別売りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The shallow one is twenty-six centimetres wide and twenty-two deep. That is smaller than the dimensions you have. The lid is sold separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 浅い箱と、その箱に合うふたを一つずつお願いします。ふたが別売りなのも確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 浅い箱と対応する別売りのふたを一つずつ購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: One shallow box and one matching lid, please. I understand that the lid is sold separately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to buy one shallow box and one separately sold matching lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、組合せを確認してお渡しします。お買上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check that they go together and give them to you. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。日用品について何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What household supplies are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の洗剤の容器に入れる詰替えを探しています。似た袋が二種類あって、どちらかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家の容器用の洗剤詰替えを探し、似た二種類のどちらか判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a detergent refill for the container at home. There are two similar bags, and I do not know which is the right one.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want a detergent refill for your container at home and cannot determine which of two similar types is right.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いの容器の商品名はわかりますか。写真でも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the product name on your container? We can also check a photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容器の写真があります。青いラベルですが、商品名の最後に「濃縮」と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真の容器は青いラベルで、商品名の最後に濃縮と書かれていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of the container. It has a blue label, but the product name ends with 'concentrated'.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the photographed container has a blue label and the product name ends with 'concentrated'.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは通常タイプ用で、こちらは濃縮タイプ用です。容器の裏側の指定も写っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is for the regular type, and this one is for the concentrated type. Does the photo also show the specifications on the back of the container?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表しか撮っていません。色が同じだからと決めず、裏側の指定を確認してから買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器の表しか撮っておらず、色で決めず裏の指定を確認してから買いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I photographed only the front. I do not want to decide just because the colour is the same; I would like to check the specifications on the back before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you photographed only the front and want to check the back's specifications before buying rather than choosing by colour.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、今日は商品名を控えておきますか。袋の対応容器の表示も撮影できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then would you like to note down the product names today? You can also photograph the bags' labels showing compatible containers.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。袋の表示を撮って、家の容器の裏と比べます。違うタイプを混ぜて使うつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋の対応表示を撮って家の容器と比べ、違うタイプを混ぜないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I will photograph the bag's label and compare it with the back of the container at home. I do not intend to mix different types together.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will photograph the bag's compatibility information and compare it with the container at home, and will not mix different types.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 迷ったらメーカーの問い合わせ先へ確認できます。今日はご購入を見送りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you are unsure, you can check with the manufacturer's enquiry contact. Will you leave the purchase for another day?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今日は買いません。指定が一致するか確認し、わからなければメーカーに尋ねてから来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は購入を見送り、指定の一致を確認し、不明ならメーカーに尋ねてから来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will not buy it today. I will check whether the specifications match, and if I am unsure I will ask the manufacturer before coming back.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not buy today, will check that the specifications match, and will ask the manufacturer before returning if unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの商品の表示はこちらです。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here are the labels for the two products. Thank you for asking.
